rules: count a token when pos1 is one of 名詞, 代名詞, 動詞, 形容詞, 形状詞, 副詞, 連体詞, 接続詞, 感動詞
exclude 固有名詞 (proper nouns) except 地名-国 (country names, e.g. 日本)
exclude 助動詞語幹 (よう/そう/みたい stems), フィラー (hesitation あの/えーと)
exclude any lemma containing characters outside hiragana, katakana, ー, 々 and CJK ideographs (digits, Latin, symbols)
key = (UniDic lemma without its disambiguation suffix, lemma reading in hiragana); counts aggregate per resolved JMdict ent_seq

resolve a key to the dict-v2 row whose written or kana forms contain the lemma or an observed base form; score: +4 primary reading equals the lemma reading, +2 any kana form equals it, +2 JMdict common, +1 head equals the lemma or the most frequent base form, +1 the lemma itself matched; ties -> lowest seq
a lemma in READING_PREFERENCES (私 わたし, 母 はは, 体 からだ, 最も もっとも, 女 おんな, 土地 とち) is scored with the preferred reading instead of UniDic's formal or alternate reading; reading_conflict records both
a lemma ending in ずる is read as the 〜じる form when the index has it (感ずる -> 感じる); lemma_normalized records the original
the lemma 於く (〜において) is excluded; nothing else is merged or overridden by hand
rank = position when sorted by aggregated token count descending, then ent_seq ascending
a key with no dict-v2 row is resolved against the full pinned JMdict when given and flagged missing_at_base; a key found nowhere is listed under unresolved
frequency_source.bias: The bank is a coverage-greedy selection of sentences (build_examples.py, 4-6 per dictionary target), so counts are frequencies within the shipped bank, not in the raw corpora; the raw corpora are not in the repo.

word_selection.rule: slots 1–500 are filled in frequency-rank order from frequency-source.json, skipping excluded_as_artifacts; words_next_500 are the following 500 by the same rule

tolerance.statement: Tolerance band: the 500 slots are cut into five bands of 100 slots in rank order; every word in a later band has a higher frequency rank than every word in an earlier band, and inside a band the words are regrouped by theme, so a word may appear at most 125 ranks earlier than the highest rank already listed (observed maximum in this draft: 102).

grouping.statement: Grouping rule: each word carries one situation id from the taxonomy of 27 situations; situations roll up into 10 themes; inside a band the words of one theme form one unit; a theme with fewer than 5 words in a band joins its first listed neighbour theme present in that band (the unit names every situation it includes and each word keeps its own situation id); units inside a band are ordered by their mean rank, and words inside a unit are ordered by rank.
